help.text: usage: cli.py [-h] [--lvgl LVGL] [--app APP] [--record | --no-record] [--build | --no-build] [--prebuilt | --source] [--scenario SCENARIO | --idle] [--yes] [--offline] [--json] Run a headless LVGL session and optionally play a scenario. arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit --lvgl LVGL LVGL version, e.g. 9.6 (default: scenario lvgl, LVGL_VERIFY_LOOP_LVGL_VERSION, or 9.6) --app APP user app variant (forwarded as LVGL_VERIFY_LOOP_DEMO); with --scenario the scenario's app is used when this flag is omitted --record, --no-record record frames and evidence files (default: on) --build, --no-build rebuild lvgl_engine from apps before launch (default: on); --no-build uses an existing build/ engine --prebuilt compile apps against the prebuilt host SDK in dist/lvgl/<version> instead of CMake --source build from engine/lvgl/<version> with CMake (default: auto; prebuilt is used when the source tree is missing) --scenario SCENARIO scenario JSON file to play after startup --idle keep the session running until Ctrl+C --yes download a missing LVGL version pack without prompting --offline never download a missing LVGL version pack --json print the session index as JSON on stdout

help.text: usage: session_report.py [-h] [--latest] [--log-tail N] [--compact] [--json] [SESSION] Read one session's evidence without starting an engine or web. The default output is the session index; query subcommands are bounded and every command accepts --json. positional arguments: SESSION session directory or manifest.json arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit --latest use the newest session under the sessions root (default) --log-tail N include the last N engine.log lines (default: 10) --compact shrink snapshots, note text and the log tail --json print the session index as one JSON object queries: timeline, diffs, frames, notes, resolve, context, feedback; visual: crop, contact-sheet, pixel, compare

help.text: usage: serve.py [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--sessions-root SESSIONS_ROOT] [--lvgl LVGL] [--build | --no-build] [--app APP] [--manage] [--open] [--exit-on-close] Serve the session viewer and live bridge. Default address: http://127.0.0.1:8765/ arguments: -h, --help show this help message and exit --host HOST bind address (default: 127.0.0.1) --port PORT TCP port; 0 picks a free port (default: 8765) --sessions-root SESSIONS_ROOT session directory (default: LVGL_VERIFY_LOOP_SESSIONS_ROOT or <repo>/sessions) --lvgl LVGL LVGL version for live sessions (default: LVGL_VERIFY_LOOP_LVGL_VERSION or 9.6) --build, --no-build rebuild lvgl_engine for live sessions (default: on); --no-build uses an existing build/ engine --app APP app to preselect and test-preview on page load; the browser URL gets ?app=NAME --manage open the app management dialog on page load; the browser URL gets ?manage=1 --open open the page in a browser after startup (default: off) --exit-on-close exit after the last tracked browser page closes (default: off; console/entrypoints/serve.pyw enables it)

texts: 点击上方「测试」进入测试，或用「录制」采集帧
本次会话没有关键画面。
显示只读像素 diff（仅证据，不判定）
测试/录制中不能标注。要标注请用上方「录制」；停止录制后会自动打开回放并定位到最后一帧。
圈出问题、写一句话即可。切到其他帧继续画，保存成一条跨帧标注；只写文字也可以。
测试预览不保存会话；「录制」会保存。要标注就在录制里操作，停止录制后会自动打开回放并定位到最后一帧。
当前没有可回放的帧。点击上方「测试」或「录制」开始，或从顶部选择其他会话。
帧、时间线与标注来自会话录制；判定由人给出。
创建后会写入源文件、app.json 和场景；下次构建自动发现，不会自动启动预览。
删除会移到 user/.trash/apps/<id>/，可恢复，也可再次确认后永久删除。
测试或录制运行中不能修改应用；停止后再试。
